closures.name: India west coast monsoon ban
closures.scope: Fishing vessels in India's EEZ beyond territorial waters on the west coast, including Lakshadweep. Non-motorised traditional craft are exempt.

closures.name: India east coast ban
closures.scope: Fishing vessels in India's EEZ beyond territorial waters on the east coast. Non-motorised traditional craft are exempt. The Andaman and Nicobar EEZ is not included here.

closures.name: Bangladesh Bay of Bengal ban
closures.scope: All fishing in Bangladesh's marine waters (58 days, aligned with India's east coast since 2025; before 2025 it was 65 days from 20 May, not analysed here).

closures.name: Pakistan shrimp closed season
closures.scope: A federal notification closes shrimp catching in the whole Exclusive Fishery Zone from 1 June to 31 July; Sindh also closes its provincial waters in June and July, but has shortened or lifted the ban early (2025: lifted on 1 July). Fishing effort from AIS cannot tell shrimp trawling from other fishing.
